paymentOwner.title: Client needed
paymentOwner.description: This OfficeRnD payment is not linked to an invoice or another document with a client. Choose who paid, or leave it out of the import.

accessDenied.title: Owners and admins only
accessDenied.description: Ask an owner of {{org}} to run this migration.

page.pageDesc: Move your workspace data to OhMyDesk with a reviewable, read-only source connection.
page.sourceHint: Choose where your existing workspace data lives.
page.previewHint: Nothing is written until the preview passes every blocker and you commit it.

source.unfinishedDesc: A previous OfficeRnD import didn't finish committing. Resume it to continue where it left off, or roll it back before starting a new one — starting fresh without resolving it isn't possible.
source.rollbackLabel: Or type ROLL BACK IMPORT to undo it instead
source.chooseSourceDesc: Select the platform you are moving from. You will choose exactly which data to bring across next.
source.officerndDesc: Import members, companies, plans, finance history, and optional workspace data through a read-only API connection.
source.nexudusDesc: Nexudus migration is not available yet. OfficeRnD remains the currently supported API source.

scope.title: Choose what to import
scope.description: Import all four blocks, or only some. A block you leave out receives no creates, updates, deletes, or replacements.

connect.orgSlugHelp: Use the short workspace name from your OfficeRnD Admin Site URL, for example {{example}}.
connect.readOnlyDesc: The selected scopes require {{count}} API v2 read permissions. Payment credentials and write permissions are never requested.
connect.oauthTitle: Create an OAuth application in OfficeRnD
connect.oauthStep1: Open Settings → Data & Extensibility → Developer Tools → Add Application.
connect.oauthStep2: Under Permissions (API v2), enable exactly the read permissions shown in the Required permissions card.
connect.oauthStep3: Save the application, open View, then copy its Client ID and Client Secret in the fields on the left.
connect.reauthDesc: Your current token is missing a newly selected permission.

preview.dependencyDesc: {{matched}} OfficeRnD record(s) match existing OhMyDesk clients and are used unchanged; {{skipped}} match nothing, so their other records are skipped.
preview.mapPlansDesc: This organization already has plans set up. Match each OfficeRnD plan to one of them, or create a new plan.
preview.companyOwnersDesc: A company is attached to its member as billing details; it is not imported as a duplicate member.
preview.ambiguousOwnerDesc: Mark exactly one billing/contact person in OfficeRnD, then rebuild the preview.
preview.ledgerDesc: Pending and failed Payments remain visible but do not affect balance. Superseded/cancelled Charges are excluded.
preview.invoiceStatusesDesc: OfficeRnD source_status and the OhMyDesk status it imports as are shown separately.
preview.rollbackLabel: To undo the entire import, type ROLL BACK IMPORT

sections.identityDesc: Review each match before importing. Existing OhMyDesk values stay unchanged unless you choose Use OfficeRnD. When Clients are not imported, only the existing clients other blocks use are listed.
sections.plansDesc: Active OfficeRnD plans become OhMyDesk plans. Months already billed by imported invoices stay history; OhMyDesk bills from the next unbilled period. Plans marked Not imported need manual activation. Visit packs keep their remaining visits and expiry; expired packs are kept as fully used history.
sections.financeDesc: Review what happens to each OfficeRnD invoice, payment, credit, and fee before importing.
sections.spacesDesc: Review each room, desk, assignment, and booking with its client, resource, and time before importing.

committing.title: Committing selected blocks
committing.description: The server commits one block at a time. If the request is interrupted, it retries automatically; closing this tab is safe, and the import resumes from where it left off next time you open this page.
committing.progress: {{percent}}% complete — processing. This can take quite a while for larger workspaces.

results.nextStepsDesc: A couple of things to finish by hand after the import.
results.billingLink: Fill in your billing details on My Space
results.resultDesc: Committed, retried, and remaining rows by block.
results.manualDesc: These OfficeRnD memberships were not auto-activated — set them up in OhMyDesk by hand, from the Calendar.
results.overlappingDesc: Both histories are retained. Resolve these in normal invoicing after reviewing both documents.
results.unclassifiedDesc: Report-only records never created a second Payment or Charge.
results.auditDesc: Original source_status remains visible after commit.
results.rollbackDesc: Rollback restores changed values and removes new records from every block in this import. Later edits or usage stop the rollback before anything is removed.
results.rollbackEligible: The server checks whether the import can be restored before changing any data.
results.rollbackConfirmLabel: Type ROLL BACK IMPORT to confirm

blockReasons.ambiguous: More than one OhMyDesk member or company owner could match this record. Remove the duplicate local match, or mark one billing/contact person in OfficeRnD, then rebuild the preview.
blockReasons.unresolved-member: These billing details cannot be attached because the related member is unresolved. Resolve the ambiguous member row above, then rebuild the preview.
blockReasons.external-link: A previous import link points to a missing or different record. Contact support before importing so we can repair the link safely.
blockReasons.excluded: This OfficeRnD record is not imported and matches no OhMyDesk client, so records that belong to it are skipped.
blockReasons.no-client: No OhMyDesk client matches this record’s OfficeRnD member or company, so it is skipped. Import that member or company too to include it.

blockReasonTitles.external-link: Previous import link is no longer valid
